scenarios.title: Convoke lets untapped creatures pay generic mana

setup.notes: Siege Wurm costs {5}{G}{G} and has convoke. The Grizzly Bears have been under A's control since the start of the turn.

decisions: A considers casting Siege Wurm, tapping both Forests for {G}{G} and tapping five untapped Grizzly Bears to pay the five generic mana.

variants.label: five_untapped
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is legal (can_play true): both Forests pay {G}{G} and five Grizzly Bears pay the generic {5}.

variants.label: one_bear_tapped
variants.delta: One of the five Grizzly Bears is already tapped.
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is not legal (can_play false): only four creatures can convoke, so {1} of the cost cannot be paid.

scenarios.title: A convoking creature pays colored mana only if it has that color

setup.notes: Siege Wurm costs {5}{G}{G} and has convoke. A controls no green mana source.

decisions: A considers casting Siege Wurm, tapping five Mountains for the generic {5} and tapping two untapped creatures to pay {G}{G}.

variants.label: green_creatures
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is legal (can_play true): each green Grizzly Bears pays one {G}.

variants.label: red_creatures
variants.delta: The two creatures are Raging Goblin (red) instead of Grizzly Bears (green).
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is not legal (can_play false): red creatures cannot pay {G}, and no green mana is available.

scenarios.title: Convoke applies to the cost after reductions

setup.notes: Heartless Summoning makes creature spells cost {2} less and gives A's creatures -1/-1 (Grizzly Bears are 1/1). Siege Wurm costs {5}{G}{G} and has convoke.

decisions: A considers casting Siege Wurm: the total cost is {3}{G}{G}; A taps both Forests for {G}{G} and three untapped Grizzly Bears for the generic {3}.

variants.label: with_reduction
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is legal (can_play true): the total cost is {3}{G}{G}, and three convoking creatures pay its generic part.

variants.label: without_reduction
variants.delta: Heartless Summoning is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is not legal (can_play false): the total cost is {5}{G}{G}, and three creatures cannot pay the generic {5}.

variants.label: one_bear_tapped
variants.delta: One of the three Grizzly Bears is tapped.
variants.expected: Casting Siege Wurm is not legal (can_play false): only two creatures can convoke against a total cost of {3}{G}{G}.
